question: In Slack: Archive the channel that our workspace owner belongs to, that was created before March 2026, and that only has 5 members. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No matching channel — nothing to archive. Here's what I found:

- **Workspace owner:** Victor Reyes (primary owner)
- He's a member of exactly one channel: **#proj-orion**, created **June 10, 2026** (not before March)
- The only channel created before March 2026 is **#watercooler** (Jan 1, 2026), but Victor isn't in it — it only has 2 members (me and Elena)

No channel satisfies all three conditions (owner is a member, created before March 2026, exactly 5 members), so I left everything as-is.
